title: The Ball Rolled toward the Wall
youtube_title: The Ball Rolled toward the Wall | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Una is just outside the fun, close to a ball you could roll toward the child against the wall. Eko changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Una has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
